chunks: Then We deliver Our apostles and those who believe. As a matter of duty We save the believers.
ai.seo_question: What is Allah's duty regarding the salvation of believers according to Surah Jonas?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine guarantee of salvation for the faithful, linking it closely to the preservation of the Prophets and the Imams as the ultimate guides. It reflects the concept of 'Haqqan' (a true right/duty) upon Allah, indicating that His mercy is not merely optional but an inevitable consequence of His justice and covenant with the believers.
